description: Forwarding several messages at once (#3838): one forward block per message, in the chat's order, then the note; next to each other and from the same chat they read as one card. See docs/protocol/protocol.md "Forwarded messages".

budget.description: Each message is cut at the smaller of `each` and `total` / the number forwarded (whole characters, rounded down); at most `most` messages go at once.
